import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static int n;
    static int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] b;
    static int[] mp;
    static int[] tot = new int[MAXN];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] v;
    static int[] f, g;

    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        long ans = 1, base = a;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ans = ans * base % MOD;
            }
            base = base * base % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) ans;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        return pow(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    static void reduce(int[] x, int idx) {
        if (x[idx] < 0) x[idx] += MOD;
        else if (x[idx] >= MOD) x[idx] -= MOD;
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int lim) {
        if ((lim /= 2) == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] += a[i + lim];
            reduce(a, i);
        }
        fwt(a, lim);
        fwt(a, lim + lim);
    }

    static void fwt2(int[] a, int lim) {
        if ((lim /= 2) == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] -= a[i + lim];
            reduce(a, i);
        }
        fwt2(a, lim);
        fwt2(a, lim + lim);
    }

    static boolean next_permutation(int[] arr) {
        int i = arr.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = arr.length - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) j--;
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
        int l = i + 1, r = arr.length - 1;
        while (l < r) {
            tmp = arr[l];
            arr[l] = arr[r];
            arr[r] = tmp;
            l++;
            r--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = in.nextInt();
        int inv100 = inv(100);
        b = new int[n * n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                a[i][j] = in.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = (int) ((long) a[i][j] * inv100 % MOD);
                b[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
            }
        }
        int totalSubsets = 1 << n;
        mp = new int[totalSubsets];
        v = new ArrayList[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < totalSubsets; ++i) {
            int pc = Integer.bitCount(i);
            v[pc].add(i);
            mp[i] = tot[pc]++;
        }
        int m = n / 2;
        int M = n - m;
        int sizeM = 1 << tot[m];
        f = new int[sizeM];
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (m * n)); ++i) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < m * n; ++j) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    p = p * b[j] % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = p * (MOD + 1 - b[j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int[] S = new int[m];
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[m]) {
                int[] s = new int[m];
                int cnt = 0;
                int temp = j;
                while (temp != 0) {
                    s[cnt++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(temp);
                    temp &= temp - 1;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < m; ++jj) {
                        if ((S[jj] >> s[jj] & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        st |= 1 << mp[j];
                        break; // found at least one permutation, no need to check others? Actually C++ code does not break; it sets st and continues permutations? But condition is if ok, set st, continue permutations (could be set multiple times, but same bit). So we keep do-while loop without break.
                    }
                } while (next_permutation(s));
            }
            f[st] = (int) ((f[st] + p) % MOD);
        }
        int sizeM2 = 1 << tot[m];
        g = new int[sizeM2]; // same size as f
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (M * n)); ++i) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < M * n; ++j) {
                int idx = j + n * m;
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    p = p * b[idx] % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = p * (MOD + 1 - b[idx]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int[] S = new int[M];
            for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[n - m]) {
                int[] s = new int[M];
                int cnt = 0;
                int temp = j;
                while (temp != 0) {
                    s[cnt++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(temp);
                    temp &= temp - 1;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < M; ++jj) {
                        if ((S[jj] >> s[jj] & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        int complement = (~j) & ((1 << n) - 1);
                        st |= 1 << mp[complement];
                    }
                } while (next_permutation(s));
            }
            g[st] = (int) ((g[st] + p) % MOD);
        }
        fwt(f, sizeM);
        fwt(g, sizeM);
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeM; ++i) {
            f[i] = (int) ((long) f[i] * g[i] % MOD);
        }
        fwt2(f, sizeM);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < sizeM; ++i) {
            ans = (ans + f[i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
